final_message:
I updated your plan for the cells exam on Monday, 2027-03-08T09:00:00-05:00. Only two Friday blocks remain, both on organelles of plant and animal cells.

- 2027-03-05T18:30:00-05:00 for 50 minutes
- 2027-03-05T19:30:00-05:00 for 30 minutes

If you complete both blocks, Milepost projects organelles at 70.7% against a 70% target. Tuesday’s practice already puts ER and Golgi protein processing and shipping on track for 65% against a 60% target.

Three skills are projected to fall short on Monday:

- Fluid mosaic model — 25.4% against a 65% target
- Diffusion and osmosis — 33.1% against a 65% target
- Pumps and energy-dependent transport — 32.8% against a 60% target
